intro: Over the past four months, ZCyberNews has tracked twelve articles on large language model security, spanning from April 8 to July 29, 2026. The coverage includes six high-severity and four medium-severity incidents, led by CVE-2026-33626, a vulnerability with a CVSS score of 7.5. The reporting primarily affects the technology, enterprise software, cloud service provider, cloud services, and cybersecurity sectors on a global scale.
